body.x: ‘Wireless USB Docking Station’ using UWB technology, developed by a Korean small-and-medium business, was demonstrated in USA.

Jiwumedia (representative Yong-Soo, Park www.jiwumedia.com) publicized a demonstration video of ‘Miracle’ used in a school class in New York, a wireless USB docking station utilizing UWB technology, at CES 2011, the biggest consumer electronics show in the world, on January.
(Picture: using Miracle of Jiwumedia in class)

Here’s a scenario of the demonstration video. A wireless sender linked to tablet PC of the teacher is connected to USB port. From now on, screen of tablet PC is looking the same on the electric large blackboard through projector. Above all, students can see the screen of the tablet PC wherever the teacher is in the classroom.

The teacher gives a question via tablet PC with touch pen and delivers it to student. The student solves the problem directly through tablet PC and all the other students can see the whole process from the electric blackboard wirelessly connected. Wireless technology linked communications among students, blackboard, and teacher.

Jiwumedia has been accelerating in business of existing digital satellite broadcasting receiver products; their JTA-1100 was chosen as priority product regarding product registration by Korea Radio Promotion Association – a part of revitalizing distribution of digital broadcasting receiver following termination of analog TV broadcasting in 2012.
